case.title: Transcript says only 'a tap', which is not in any keyword list, so the check stays silent

submissions.open_text: Bills arrive irregularly and sometimes doubled.
submissions.voice_transcript: We fetch from a tap down the road and pay five shillings per jerrycan.

case.why: A lone 'tap' is not a keyword: the lists contain only phrases such as 'own tap', 'tap at home', 'public tap' and 'communal tap'. No word in the transcript begins a keyword ('from a' is not 'buy from'; 'tap down' is not 'tap inside'). With no keyword the check never fires, even though the story suggests a public tap while the form says piped_home. An implementation that maps bare 'tap' to public_tap would fire wrongly.
